name: Jari Mäkinen
bio:
Jari's motorsport journey began in his youth, fueled by a passion for rally racing in the Finnish countryside. While his own driving career peaked at regional levels, his analytical mind and knack for understanding vehicle dynamics led him to a career in motorsport management. He transitioned from a small rally team to Formula 3, then endurance racing, eventually finding his niche in coordinating test driver programs for larger teams. At McLaren, Jari excels at balancing the needs of the engineering team with the development goals of individual drivers, ensuring test sessions are productive and contribute meaningfully to car development. He's known for his calm demeanor, his ability to mediate between strong personalities, and for providing insightful feedback based on a deep understanding of telemetry data and driver input.

Jari's success lies in his ability to see the big picture. He focuses on ensuring every test contributes to the long-term goals of the team, rather than getting bogged down in minor details. He is a mentor to the younger drivers, helping them understand not just how to drive faster, but how to provide the kind of feedback that engineers can use to improve the car. His focus on clear communication and his unwavering dedication to the team's objectives have made him an invaluable asset to McLaren.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline.
